title: Fixed resolving constraint diagram data
statement: For four monoidal categories A,B,C,D and functors F:A→B, L:C→D, q:A→C, r:B→D, choose binary localization maps s:qP⊗qQ→q(P⊗Q), t:rP⊗rQ→r(P⊗Q), a natural transformation ε:q⋙L→F⋙r, ordinary oplax arrows β and unit, and regular-unit isomorphisms. Define the left and right nested localization maps by tensoring s with an identity and then applying s. Define pairModel=L(s)≫ε and six vertex maps by their prescribed nested pairModel, ε and t composites. RepresentativeEquations is the binary representative equation and scalar-unit equation. EdgeIdentification consists of the six commutative edge squares; VertexInvertibility says these vertex maps are isomorphisms, and AssociativityPaths identifies both full paths and asserts their equality. Define regularLeft and regularRight using the inverse unit comparison and the unitor. UnitIdentification records all unit vertex isomorphisms, edge squares, both full-path formulas and both path equalities. UnitEdgeIdentification records just its vertex isomorphisms, three edge squares and opposite branch on each side. Specialize these formulas to the fixed section cochain/derived operations, modelTensor=qTensor.app, transported derived monoidal structure and specified localized regular comparison; obtain ResolvingClosure, SectionHypotheses, SectionVertices, SectionEdges, SectionAssociativity, SectionUnits and SectionUnitEdges. Specializing instead to the fixed internal/section derived equivalences and inverse γ and θ gives Conjugation, InternalEdges and InternalUnits. The underlying operations are those of the existing statement dependencies, including [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]; none is chosen anew.
